description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'LicenseSearchFilterParams' used for filtering license search results within the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base filter parameters class and specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: LicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for license search filtering, allowing setting of a sort field and defining allowed sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of LicenseSearchFilterParams and sets the default sort field to 'l.name'.
